summary: Establish a defect mechanism through a faithful reproduction and discriminating experiments.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: Observed symptom, expected behavior, affected scope, and available incident or reproduction evidence.

inputs.name: project-context
inputs.description: Relevant execution path, ownership, environment, and verification facilities.

inputs.name: change-set
inputs.description: A suspected change or candidate regression boundary.

completion_checks: The reproduction matches the reported symptom or the mismatch is explicit.
The causal explanation is supported by discriminating observations.
A bounded repair direction and regression check are identified.
failure_modes: Required environment or evidence cannot be accessed: blocked.
The symptom cannot be reproduced or hypotheses remain indistinguishable: inconclusive.
